# security-openbao-eso-store

<!-- BEGIN DECLARED (generated by scripts/wiki-compile.py — do not edit) -->

> Source comment, verbatim from `kustomization.yaml`:
>
> OpenBao as an External Secrets store — applied on top of security/openbao via components:
>
> Adds:
> - ClusterSecretStore openbao (external-secrets.io/v1): provider vault, kv-v2 at kv/,
> auth/kubernetes role external-secrets with ESO's own ServiceAccount
>
> Requires:
> - security/external-secrets (ESO >= 0.17 serves external-secrets.io/v1; chart 2.3.0 here)
> - scripts/openbao/bootstrap.sh run once: it enables kv-v2 and auth/kubernetes and
> binds role external-secrets to ServiceAccount external-secrets/external-secrets
> with policy external-secrets (read kv/data/workloads/*, nothing else)
> - the external-secrets namespace opted in to the openbao NetworkPolicy. Without the
> label the store stays InvalidProviderConfig and the ESO log shows the login to
> auth/kubernetes failing with "connection refused" (k3s; other CNIs time out
> instead), not a permission error:
> kubectl label ns external-secrets ait.aitizate.com/openbao-access=true
>
> Usage in overlay kustomization.yaml:
> resources:
> - path/to/security/openbao
> components:
> - path/to/security/openbao/eso-store
>
> Write secrets under kv/workloads/ and reference them without the kv/ mount
> (the store adds it, and data/ for kv-v2):
> bao kv put -mount=kv workloads/demo password=...
> ---
> apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
> kind: ExternalSecret
> metadata:
> name: demo
> spec:
> refreshInterval: 1h
> secretStoreRef:
> kind: ClusterSecretStore
> name: openbao
> target:
> name: demo
> data:
> - secretKey: password
> remoteRef:
> key: workloads/demo
> property: password
> # or every key of the secret:  dataFrom: [{extract: {key: workloads/demo}}]
>
> Anything outside kv/workloads/ (kv/agents/... for instance) is denied: the
> ExternalSecret goes to SecretSyncedError and the ESO log shows a 403 from OpenBao.
>
> dataFrom.find is not supported: it lists kv/metadata/workloads, and the policy only
> reads kv/data/workloads/*. data and dataFrom.extract need nothing more. A tenant that
> wants find adds `list` on kv/metadata/workloads/* to policies/external-secrets.hcl.
> The store reports capability ReadWrite, but PushSecret is denied for the same reason.
>
> Tenant overlay can patch:
> - metadata.name (e.g. a use case that expects "corporate-store")
> - nothing for the namespace: if OpenBao does not run in `security`, the
> follow-namespace/ transformer rewrites spec.provider.vault.server (see there)
> - serviceAccountRef / role if ESO runs under another ServiceAccount or namespace
> (run bootstrap.sh with the same ESO_SA_NAME / ESO_SA_NAMESPACE)
>
> Cluster-scoped: this component sets no namespace. An overlay `namespace:` still
> stamps one on it (kustomize does not know the CRD's scope); kubectl drops it on apply.
